text:
Jordan C (Acme Health): Hi team — prepping for a security/compliance review tied to our POC. Need clear answers this week: what audit logs will we get for a POC (hosted API keys vs dedicated pool vs private), retention options, who can read them, KMS/encryption details, key rotation, and whether Redwood can forward logs to our Splunk HEC (TLS + token). Also SOC2 artifacts/evidence needed for our security team. Can you confirm?

Maya (sales): Thanks Jordan — noted. We can provision a POC in hosted or dedicated. Quick Q: do you need 365d retention or shorter? And for Splunk, can you share the HEC endpoint + token & whether you need IP allowlisting? I'll loop in engineering/security to give specifics.

Jordan C (Acme Health): 365d retention preferred. We will provide HEC endpoint/token. IP allowlist is possible but we'd prefer TLS+token only for now. SOC2 Type II report + evidence of KMS usage and access controls are must-haves. Also need to know if hosted API keys mean Redwood employees can see request payloads.

Luke H: Quick summary from infra side:
- Hosted API: audit logs (metadata) are retained in Redwood's audit store by default. Default retention 90d, enterprise/POC can be bumped to 365d. Logs include API key id, request metadata (model, latency, token counts), timestamps, and an opaque request hash. We do NOT store customer plaintext prompt outputs in the standard audit log unless you opt-in to full request capture.
- Dedicated pool: you get the same audit log exports but we can also enable direct syslog/TLS->Splunk forwarding or S3 export to your bucket encrypted with a customer CMK.
- Private/VPC: full control — logs can be kept in your environment, integrated with your KMS/HSM, and never leave your VPC for the POC.

For Splunk HEC forwarding we support HTTPS POST to your HEC endpoint. We'll need:
1) HEC endpoint URL
2) HEC token (we store it encrypted)
3) Optional IP allowlist (we can provide outbound IP ranges)

Example minimal forwarder config (we can send a deployable container):
```
SPLUNK_HEC_URL=https://hec.acme-corp.com:8088/services/collector/event
SPLUNK_HEC_TOKEN=XXXX-REDACTED-XXXX
curl -k -H "Authorization: Splunk $SPLUNK_HEC_TOKEN" -d '{"event":"{\"apiKeyId\":\"ak-123\",\"model\":\"redwood/gpt-96k\",\"latency_ms\":120}"}' $SPLUNK_HEC_URL
```

Priya R: Security notes:
- Hosted keys: Redwood-generated API keys are stored encrypted at rest; Redwood employees do not have raw access to plaintext keys. For request data, the default audit log does not include full request body. If you request full-request capture for troubleshooting we require an explicit opt-in and will mark data handling in the SOW.
- KMS: For Dedicated we can encrypt exports with your AWS KMS CMK. For Private we can integrate with your HSM or KMS.
- Key rotation: API keys can be rotated on demand; we recommend a 90-day rotation cadence for long-lived keys. For Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed keys and rotation policies.
- Artifacts: we can provide a SOC2 Type II summary, control matrix, and redacted logs for the POC under NDA. Full evidence (raw audit bundles) requires an MSA/NDA and a security intake.

Maya (sales): Action items I can take this morning: 1) send POC onboarding checklist + minimal SOW for 365d retention and Splunk forwarding, 2) start NDA request for SOC2 artifacts, 3) estimate for Dedicated pool pricing for a 2-week POC with burst capacity.

Jordan C (Acme Health): Please add a sample redacted audit log entry — our security team wants to see structure. Also include what fields are PII or could contain customer data if full capture is enabled.

Luke H: Sample redacted audit event (we redact prompt text unless opted-in):
```
{
  "timestamp":"2026-06-15T18:42:01Z",
  "tenant_id":"acme-tenant-94",
  "api_key_id":"ak-REDACTED",
  "request_hash":"sha256:3a7f...",
  "model":"redwood-open-7b-v2",
  "tokens_in":24,
  "tokens_out":46,
  "latency_ms":112,
  "outcome":"success",
  "forwarded_to":"splunk",
  "note":"prompt_redacted"
}
```
Fields that may contain customer data if full capture is enabled: `request_body`, `response_text`. These are never included in standard audit entries unless you explicitly opt-in.

Priya R: Also adding: if you require raw audit bundles for forensic review we will deliver them to an S3 bucket encrypted with your CMK and include key rotation logs and KMS access logs. That delivery will be timeboxed for the POC and needs approval via security intake.

Maya (sales): I'll send the onboarding doc + sample SOW and start the NDA this morning. Expect an email within 2 hours. If you want Dedicated POC pricing now: estimated $6k for a 2-week small Dedicated pool (includes 4 GPU hours baseline + 1TB audit export). I'll put detailed line items in the SOW.

Jordan C (Acme Health): Great, thanks everyone. We'll share the HEC endpoint/token via secure channel and sign the NDA. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

Maya (sales): Thanks Jordan — we'll get this provisioned once NDA is in place and HEC details are received. I'll follow up with Luke & Priya if we need an IP allowlist or outbound ranges.

Jordan C (Acme Health): Ack'd.
